classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0035523) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0097042) activities; characterize via sequence-level analysis and ESM3 language-model embeddings; produce per-class ranked candidate lists
assumptions: GO:0035523 is assigned to ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (NNRD/YjeF_N superfamily); term identity confirmed via literature_search nodes
GO:0097042 is assigned to NADPHX epimerase activity (NNRE/YjeF_C superfamily); term identity confirmed via literature_search nodes
aspect=molecular_function is correct for both GO terms
max_sequences=200 per term balances phylogenetic breadth with analysis tractability; can be raised to 500 for broader coverage
No taxon filter applied; all-kingdom diversity is scientifically valuable for conservation analysis of this ancient metabolite-damage repair pathway
reviewed=null includes both Swiss-Prot (high-confidence) and TrEMBL entries; Swiss-Prot annotation quality propagates into rank scoring via confidence signals
exclude_iea=false retains electronically inferred annotations to maximise phylogenetic coverage across poorly-annotated clades
ESM3 foreach runs on representative_sequences emitted by sequence_analysis for each class; max_parallel=3 respects typical single-GPU budget
representative_sequences items from sequence_analysis expose a .sequence field (amino-acid string) suitable as ESM3 sequence input
Structure and embedding tracks in ESM3 produce confidence_scores that are the primary discriminating signal for rank_designs
ph=7.4 used for charge and pI calculations as physiological cytosolic default
Two independent rank_designs calls produce per-class ranked lists; cross-class comparison is performed on the final ranked_candidates outputs from each node

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair enzyme dehydratase epimerase YjeF NNRD NNRE metabolite damage
